reviews.text: Yacep. I can’t not upload my certificate on yoga alliance because your not appear as a yacep
Like the Content but App Disappointing. I enjoy the content but won’t renew due to glitchy app that makes it difficult to enjoy my practice when using.

App is terrible. Grey-out band over videos in landscape mode? No-click no-link classes and courses? After an hour of “playing around” with the app (that’s too much time -it’s 2024 not 2006) I’m deleting app and cancelling membership.

App is just too glitchy. I do like the content, but this is a review in the App Store and the developers really need to respond to problems with the app. I want to use the app on my TV because it’s easier to see, but the current version won’t let me complete log in. Previously, the app just wouldn’t open on the TV. On my iPad and phone, it works pretty consistently but is hard to see, and I can’t project it to my TV. The saving features also don’t really make sense.

Incompetent thieves. I payed for a yearly subscription and have yet to have the access I have been in communication with incompetent Cheryl who is just stealing company time!!!
IM STILL WAITING!!!

Terrible customer service you can’t get in touch with anyone. I purchased the yearly membership last year so I could do prenatal yoga classes. I didn’t even use this app much since there are not many prenatal videos and I ended up finding better classes for free in YouTube. I canceled my subscription from my App Store months ago and I even deleted this app. Yesterday I was charged $204 for another year when I did not receive any notice just the notification from my credit card. I’m trying to get in touch with someone and all they have is an email. ?????? Makes no sense, they make it impossible to get rid of this membership.

Needs a major update. Yoga International was once a great resource, initiated by the Himalayan Institute to teach very sound and beneficial yoga asana, meditation, and pranayama courses online via some very good teachers. Sadly, YI was sold in late 2021 to another company who promptly removed some very good content and over time, new content from the very good teachers gave way to quite substandard content mostly by teachers brought over by the acquiring firm. Nothing against the new teachers personally, it’s just that the new content was quite insufficient vs. what had previously been offered under original ownership. In late 2023, we cancelled our membership, the end of quite a few good years of practice.

Doesn’t support screen rotation on an ipad. This app is developed for vertical orientation and a cellphone. Given it’s subject matter, I more often like to use my iPad for the larger screen. If you’re iPad is in a support case, you’ll notice it won’t rotate for horizontal viewing. An update to allow this would be a great improvement to this app.

Would love to use. I would love to use this app. But I’m on a fixed income, which means that I can’t afford any subscriptions. I’m Blind and Disabled as well. All the money I get goes to rent, bills, and food. This means that subscriptions are completely out of the question. It would be nice if you guys could figure out a way to make the app free for those of us on a fixed income. I’m trying to get back into yoga after a long absence. Please consider finding a way to make the app free for people on fixed incomes. It would help a lot.

app - 2⭐️ at most, content - 5⭐️. As a yoga instructor and yoga student I enjoy the content of YI for several years now. I found teachers, courses and other content I enjoy, use in my classes and personal practice. Sadly the usability of the app is left much to be desired. I view it on my iPad most of the time. The size of videos doesn’t fit to the screen when I open them (I have to switch to another app, then back, and by chance the app would show video full screen). I can’t open videos from my saved list and have to type in the name of the class in a search to get an access to smth I already saved. The web version and mobile app version do not really sync (I had issues while viewing my purchased courses). Sometimes a teacher’s intro video plays over a class video (!!), because it just has an autoplay… There are many more annoying issues. They need a good QA team on board to check on all that bugs, both mobile app and web. I don’t want to level up on my subscription because all these bugs.

Automatically takes money. They automatically will charge you card for over $200 and not inform you until AFTER it is done. They don’t reach out to let you know membership is expiring and ask if you want to keep. Then there is basically no way to contact them. There is a text/chat box but it is automated bot answer..then you wait for a team member to get back to you “as soon as they can”.
Thought to cancel and will be charged. Out to get your money …

Website is GREAT, the app is TERRIBLE. I’ve been a web subscriber for years, and the content on YI is no nonsense, solid information. 

I recently downloaded the app to have mobile access to a course, but the screen goes blank almost every time I try to progress. I can’t even go back to the Home Screen on the app. 

It’s not until I come back a day or two later that I can access the app at all. 

Stay a subscriber to their content, but don’t bother with the app.

App and Website Issues Detract From Great Videos. The videos and teachers are amazing, but the UX design in the app and website both are designed for someone who wants to find a random yoga class, similar to searching for a single class in YouTube. Where the app and website fail is that we (users) cannot easily organize or save ‘members only’ courses, classes, find followed teachers. I will keep using the app and update as I experiment with it.
Wear your seat belt. Crashes frequently. Some stuff (courses) I can’t even view as it crashes every time I try and open.
Complain. Need to cancel and the app does not give the option…no answer to this process

First impressions. I haven’t used the app yet, but have a terrible first impression. I’m a 43-year old woman who wasn’t able to have kids and I have a lot of grief around that. Grief that I am trying to work through with yoga and meditation. 

I filled out the kind of things I was interested in, and prenatal classes weren’t even on the list. But the very first recommended class was for prenatal/postpartum. So pronatalistic of you, Yoga International. Just because I am a woman under 50 does NOT mean I want suggestions for prenatal yoga classes. 

I hope the developers consider this. I have asked how to remove recommendations (is t obvious, if it’s possible).

Worst customer service. Trying to cancel a membership is the hardest thing to do and there’s pretty much no customer service except an online chat box that you’ll lose upon leaving the browser. It’s pretty ridiculous

They will take your money but lock you out of the app!. Tried to access the app after a few month break. They still happily took my money but wouldn’t provide any support to reset my account. I didn’t want to cancel but I didn’t have a choice as customer service kept giving me guidance that didn’t work. It’s a shame because the instructors were great but the bad business and shady practices ruined it.
Disappointing app quality. Such a cumbersome, slow, subpar app. Also the video stream stops and breaks too often. I can tell this app was a very cheap investment.

HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!!!. Been trying to cancel for DAYS now! The instructions on the website tell me to click buttons that don’t exist but yet they keep trying to charge my debit card for a service I DON’T WANT!! And if I send a chat message I get a reply that says they reply in a day... but when they reply it’s telling me the same thing the website already said to do with buttons that aren’t there for me to click!!!! CANCEL MY MEMBERSHIP AND STOP TRYING TO CHARGE MY CARD!!!!!!
Good content, Bad app. This app is organized in a bizarre way and incredibly buggy and difficult to navigate. Unfortunate since the content is fairly good.

Great content, serious interfacing issues. I’ve had this app for a few months and the idea behind it is great. They have great classes from a variety of teachers. However, the app needs a serious overhaul. Everything about it is not user friendly. Trying to saving classes for future use is a nightmare. They all go to one place and you can’t categorize them. You can only put them in a certain order in one giant list so I’ve created “playlists” in a way but this is the biggest nightmare of them all. It took me about 45 minutes to organize maybe 50 classes so that my yin classes aren’t all intertwined with my strong flow classes. Every time you move a class anywhere in the list, it takes you all the way to the top of list. Then you have to scroll back down to continue organizing. The other frustrating part is the fact that if the class has a long name (like longer than 5 words) there is no way of knowing what it’s called. From the list you can read about 4 words and even after clicking on the class, you can read about 5 and then... this is a huge problem when trying to decide what class to begin. Especially considering every time you click on a class it resets the suggestions and takes you to the top again so you have to commit to a class based on a thumbnail and half the title. It’s really not what I want to deal with when trying to be in a state of peace so I find myself opting not to use the app at all sometimes if I’m anxious or have low patience.. which are exactly the times I’d like to have someone else guide me through a practice... in this day and age and for $20 a month with I’m sure hundreds of thousands of subscribers, you could really stand to pay someone to fix these fundamental problems. The last time I used something so bug ridden was using a motorola droid with nearly the first edition of android operating system running it. I expect more for the price I pay. If the problem is not resolved soon, I’ll look for another service provider or just go back to YouTube where things are simple and free to boot

Wishing for offline streaming. I LOVE THE CONTENT!!! But I wish the app was more user friendly, especially in its ability to watch offline, and easier save videos to favorite AFTER watched (I always have to go searching for the video I just did to save it when I loved it)

Don't buy. It's normal to see Yoga mistaken for being a workout, when it's actually an integral part of the Yogic(Hindu) path to enlightenment. What's not normal is individual instructors telling you to do whatever silly thing they thought of in the shower yesterday. I broke my arm on the first lesson.
A worthless piece of stuff. Don’t waste your money on this app.

The app and website crashes.. I paid for the annual subscription fee and deeply regret it as the application and website is the most frustrating thing I have to deal with on a daily basis. I avoid using this service solely because of how horrible the website is designed, which is sadly a waste of money. It’s also almost impossible to download any videos like it claims you can if you sign up for a year. Please fix this.

Technical Glitches. I’ve enjoyed the content over the last several months to get my daily exercise in. However, for a while now you cannot pause or skip or rewind in the video at any point without having to start it over. It just freezes indefinitely. This has killed my morning yoga buzz multiple times now. Received a call mid-workout and just denying the call crashed the video. Unable to reboot and skip to where I was. This app needs some extra tech support love.

Yoga with a bit of scam!!. I hate to write a bad review but 4 months ago I tried this site for 1 months , and since I don’t really use it as much I decide to cancel it in the same month. 

For some reason that cancellation didn’t go through , even tho it says Processing! I thought all good, until 4 months later I saw they have been charging my acc that I don’t use. 

So 4 month after I tried again to cancel and it says , PROCESSING . But never actually canceled. I didn’t get any confirmation and ect. I assume a lot of people get fooled here. 

I contacted the costumer service explaining the whole thing and they said they are like Netflix and can’t really refund! What a lame answer sorry but not sorry . but this is a difficult time , if you want to scam and take advantage of people please don’t use the name yoga!

Do not take the free trial. They offer a free trial then make it impossible to cancel! Their help/support gives you instructions to cancel that are not possible to execute as the screen shots are fake and not what is really in the app.

It is a trap!!! Not an ethical business! STAY AWAY!!. I’m trying to get into yoga. So I downloaded this app to check it out. I gave them all my goals and wishes (new to yoga/relaxation/meditation) and the system showed me weird options each time. I tried two of them. The videos are lame. Instructions are not clear for new beginners. There are many varieties of yoga and they talk that language for a new comer like me it’s difficult to follow. 
So I switched to youtube for easier search options and found a bunch of cool stuff. I tried to cancel the free trial membership on the application. There was no such thing. I reached out to their help and asked them to cancel it. They sent me a shortcut to their website which didn’t lead to any page with a cancelation option. 
So I texted them again and in the meantime they charged me for the next month. I reached out and asked for a refund explaining how I wasn’t able to use their app. They said ‘sorry no refunds’ and extended my membership for 2 months instead (still no cancelation mind you!). 
This can’t be legal. I’m going to complain about them to everywhere possible. 
STAY AWAY!!!

Terrible customer service. I never used this, forgot about it and I cancelled my membership the day they charged my card and when I asked about a refund they refused. Says a lot about a company profiting off of people who forget to cancel their free trial rather than true subscribers.
LOVE the classes, hate the apps. This freezes up on my iPad, and crashes Roku. I’m so disappointed. So many yoga interruptus sessions.

Buggy app. Every time I push pause it won’t play again. Also, the suggested videos are rarely what I have asked for in my settings. It suggests all levels of videos when I should really only be doing 1 and 2. I also like to bookmark videos that I might want to try in the future but I wish the bookmarks page would give more information on the video than it does.

The videos themselves are pretty good though.
Impossible to cancel. It was impossible to cancel membership after free trial. Had to cancel credit card.

Classes and instructors are great, software needs some work. App is clunky and non responsive. Play/pause is unresponsive and inconsistent when casting. Courses don’t save your progress as you work through them. App often closes itself if you switch to a different task (like a text message).

I’ll keep using it for the quality of the teachers and their classes. But the app itself is pretty frustrating to use as of now.

Zero star. Zero star if feasible.
Ripped off

How about prop free yoga in light of covid?. Kind of disappointing to go on your app and see all these newly uploaded classes that are really prop heavy .. in light of covid I’m teaching outdoors or in a studio without any props .. please bring in some material on this please. Thanks!!

Total Scam!. I tried to cancel my membership a month ago (literally after I signed up for the trial and realized it wasn’t for me, a little to hippy dippy for my liking) but apparently the cancellation didn’t go through. I haven’t used the service AT ALL and only discovered that the cancellation didn’t go through when I saw the charge on my CC. I immediately contacted the company (via chat because they no longer have a customer service department) explaining the issue and asking for a refund. They’re reply was while I couldn’t get my money back, I’d be able to use a service THAT I DON’T WANT for the next month. Thanks but no thanks, total rip off!

Be aware of cancellation process. I tried canceling my YI membership through the app in Spring, but Yoga International kept pulling payments via PayPal for two additional months. I needed to go into the PayPal app and cancel as well. Terrible procedures, and canceling via that app should cancel the payments.

Worst Customer Service. I have never been so disappointed in a service. I was charged by this company for no reason, I never signed up. DREA accuses me of being abusive when I was not. I had just asked for a refund because I did not enroll in this service and was ignored. She was very rude offered no sympathy and did nothing to correct the situation or try to offer support. DREA just wanted to pretend it would go away by doing nothing and by not keeping me updated with the situation. She was not helpful, not caring, not considerate.
Great content, terrible apps. I really liked the classes but the iPhone and Apple TV apps are just not good. Freeze all the time, can’t save favorites. 5 star content, 1 star apps.

Sustaining. Sustaining through hard times!! My definition of Yoga International!!
Betsy
Airplay. Does not support Apple Airplay.
New look!!!. I love the new look to the app!!!!! It brings all of your amazing and deep content together. It looks great!
Loving it so far. It’s only my second day using the app. However the practices are challenging, The teachers are engaging.

Hacks to get you through. And, it’s worth it. I have been using this app for years both on my iPod and my computer. It is true that favorites don’t transfer between devices. However if you save favorites on each device they will remain saved. Sometimes the favorites screen freezes, but if you tap on a class and go back to the screen it will scroll again. Sometimes the whole app just won’t load, like today, and when that happens I delete the app and reload it. So remember the email and password you used when you signed up. It actually doesn’t take that long. 

There’s so much amazing content in this app that all of this is worth it. There are many knowledgeable teachers there are good courses and there are classes of all lengths of time and a wide range of abilities. What I love most about this app and this site is that it is so completely inclusive and has classes for anyone of any age any size and any ability. Other yoga sites and yoga apps portray the yogi In an unrealistic manner and reinforce negative and damaging content and images. 

It is also important to note that this site/app is not just about Asana. Which if you know anything about yoga, asana is only one limb of eight. There is meditation, pranayama and philosophy offered throughout the site and many of the teachers obviously have a rich background in the other 7 limbs of ashtanga yoga as taught by patanjali thousands of years ago.

The app is broken. I tried to use it but none of the buttons work. I can’t use filters, see my profile, courses nor mediations or favorites. I’ve tried on my iPad and my iPhone, but no luck. The website is great, but this app is useless unless you want to only do one from the featured page.
Contenido excelente, app mala.. La app es lenta, poco funcional, tiene mal diseño. Deberia actualizarse o modificarse para ser excelente como su comtenido.
Review. So far best app I have ever used, very beneficial yoga international keeps me coming back every day.

Beware of charges! Do NOT UPGRADE. Did a trial to see courses and was autocharged for $15 for 6 months. Haven’t even opened the app in 5 months and didn’t realize I was being charged.
Of course they wouldn’t refund - so feeling scammed. Big waste of money.

Unless this is your gym and you use it regularly, this is not worth it. Youtube has great content. Beware
Crash. The app keeps crashing, I had to push the play button x4 during a ten min meditation. Very annoying, sorry

Love!!. My favorite app! I was paying for a gym membership for yoga classes and the times they offered were so inconvenient. With this membership I’m able to practice my yoga/meditation anywhere at a time that’s most convenient for me.

Buyer beware. I bought a Bluetooth device and along with it came a membership to this website and two others . I never opened this website and used it but I did use the other one pandora for the three free month period . When I went to cancel this and the pandora I couldn’t get them canceled I finally had to put in dispute on My credit card to get rid of but by then this company said I owed them for 5 months . About $75 . Amazing I never used this at all not one class or what ever they call this app I don’t even know the name of this company , I would call it scam yoga. I never knew if I liked yoga but now I know I hate yoga what negative energy to charge someone for something they never used.
I’m a senior on very limited income how desperate to make charges unfairly on the people that aren’t that good on internet. I called them but the phone message is you can’t reach anyone on this call don’t leave a message . 
On the positive side I would like to thank pandora they cut off the service with no charges . If I ever again buy anything on internet it will be pandora ! 
So buyer beware this company is apparently desperate for your money.

Disappointed. App would sometimes not load or the sound wouldn’t work. Used the website instead and the instruction was just ok. One instructor constantly verbally stumbled throughout an entire lesson like a new teacher. Was really hoping to love this subscription, but no luck.

7 class options for a filter of basic options. I requested 60 min class, level 2/3, Vinyasa style.
With that I get a prenatal class???

Log in issues. I’m unable to log in to the app.
After emailing support they just suggested I log in to the website. No solutions were offered.
Perfect if you can’t get to class!!. Excellent class substitute

Awful app. I love Yoga International’s content from classes to articles to online trainings... but the app is awful. The app doesn’t seem to transfer to my account even though I’m signed in and most content won’t load on the app. Frankly, I don’t even bother with the app anymore. I check in occasionally hoping they’ve fixed all the glitches and streamlined the app, but no. If you’re going to launch an app for your business, then do it right. Yoga International has missed the mark entirely.
Thank you!. So much information at my fingertips! Love the accountability wheels.
Good content, clunky app. The content is great but the app is difficult to use. Make it less buggy!

Terrible user experience. The videos are great but actually using the app or through the website is horrific. I open a video and my phone has to stay open the entire time or my video cuts off. I hate popping up over and over again to turn my guided meditation or yoga set on again and again. The website offers options to really search for the right meditation but the app doesn’t have those same options so when I try to find a video in the app that I found on their website it’s a nightmare, and the search system doesn’t actually take you to what you want half the time. Now I’m trying to edit my membership and delete it because *barf* and they have me in an endless loop of cancel your membership here, with no actual option to cancel. I’m gravely disappointed in this company. It is more functional to just use YouTube videos.

Unauthorized Charges. I signed up for a free trial months ago and cancelled the membership before my free trial was up. Yoga International has charged me for a membership without my authorization. I received no notice from the company and found out after reviewing charges to my bank account. Super sneaky, Yoga International, and not cool.

For the most part it’s great. It’s got everything I’m looking for in a yoga app, however, I’ve run into a few issues. The app itself can be a bit laggy sometimes and I am unable to link my account with my amazon devices which would give me a more diverse usage of the app. And as far as maintaining a membership goes, in the iPhone app, there is only the option of using the trial and then starting the $15/month subscription and no way to use a promo code for a several month subscription, which I happen to have from. Just slightly confused but eager to use this app to its fullest 😊

App crashes my Roku. Every time I try to use this on my TV, the app crashes a minimum of 2 times. The Roku app ends up restarting automatically and then I have to search back to whatever program I was in and restart it. 
This would be an awesome service if the tech and tech support was adequate. The app may work o. My phone, but that tiny screen is not a useful medium for me. Hopefully it improves or I will cancel membership.
Problems. It keeps freezing!

Don’t do it!!!!!. I joined up over Thanksgiving based on the reviews. The area I do yoga is in my family room and I use my TV to view it (Roku). It is slow and there are issues with the app on my TV, I spent 45 minutes trying several avenues to get it to work (several occasions), missed my time for yoga and the only resolution was that I was not able to see the screen. I asked for a refund and the “issues” have begun. The response I received was inadequate and clearly the person who responded sent a scripted response, and has no understanding of my membership. I asked for the issue to be sent to a supervisor...the response is silence. What a disappointment, my view of this company is quickly changing.

Terrible tech issues. I purchased a membership with the highest of hopes. I loved everything I saw & was eager to begin classes. I used the roku app on my tv (brand new roku device, only a month old), it crashed 8 times in a 30 minute class. So I tried another tv in the house with a different roku app (roku tv, 3 months old). Again it crashed constantly. I resorted to trying to finish the class on my phone (brand new iPhone 11) again, the classes crashed. After spending nearly 3 hours to take a 30 minute beginner class I finally gave up and cancelled. I love that you have classes for the absolute beginner & for the mobility challenged, but I can’t take 3 hours to do my yoga each day. You have a great foundation, but your tech is just terrible. I may come back if these issues were resolved because the classes are legit.
BEWARE DO NOT SUBSCRIBE. Do not even do the free trial. There is no way to cancel the subscription and they will just keep taking your money

Content is great, but.... The content is very good, enjoyable, and informative. However, the IPad app is a bit clunky, and the the Apple TV app, I can’t even sign in. I’m sure it’s just a work in progress.

App never works!. I love yoga international! And their app has never worked for me. No matter what phone software update I have, no matter how much space is on my phone, the videos never work properly [e.g. no sound], or at all, the app will either crash or send me back to the beginning of my search. I really hope they develop a better app! It would be so nice!

Great app but technical problems. I absolutely love this app but it closes while I’m using it, which is especially frustrating during meditation. I have been circling my finger on the screen but that disrupted my meditation. Please fix this bug!!!! 🙏🏻😭🙏🏻

Love the site, not the app. Such a frustrating experience!! It has issues from login to
Search. Just not an enjoyable experience to navigate or use - IF you can get it to respond.

Don’t buy this. It will drive you nuts. The content is great and once you access it you will want it, but the instability and poor system design will drive you bonkers. Have a favorite class? If you find it once on your iPhone you will never find it on you laptop or roku device, because favorites don’t transfer. Roku app crashes constantly (thought the workout room was a good plan, think again). iPhone app sometimes scrolls but usually doesn’t, so you will only be able to access the first two classes on any list. Contest crashing across all platforms, and search function is terrible, especially on the roku app, you can search the literal entire name for a course you are staring at on your phone and never find it on your laptop or roku. This app might have been a revelation in 2004 but it is an absolute embarrassment in 2019. Don’t waste your money.

Great App with Some flaws. The interface needs work. The search engine often lags and makes it difficult to find classes. The selection is great but the would be better if the interface was smoother and easier to navigate. (I.e. find classes by body part or being able to type in key words)

Impossible to cancel membership. This was the worst app purchase I have ever made. There is no way to manage your subscription. You can only email customer support and they never respond. There is no customer service phone number.

Worst app purchase - do not recommend anyone purchase this app.
Top resource. My go-to source for expanding my practice! Thank you!
Fix this and app please!. This app is so buggy! There are so many things wrong with it. It’s unfortunate because they have great content. I just usually get so frustrated with the app that I give up.
Filter. The app is not bad but it does freeze often, however, what bothers me the most is that the classes can’t be sorted by ‘most popular’.

Good yoga resource but the app needs some upgrades. I love yoga international. It is a professional resource for quality instructions and teachings in yoga asana and philosophy and science.
However, the app is not very well designed.

1) the search bar does not fit on the iPhone X screen and hides behind the time bar, which makes it difficult to start writing. The search engine itself is very slow too.

2) many courses I signed up for are not available in the app, which makes the app often irrelevant since I have to use my browser. 

3) the breakup of the different categories isn’t user friendly.

Excellent classes. I enjoy and increase my creativity in teaching my yoga students through your excellent site.
Namaste

Inspirational. As a yoga teacher in the suburbs, I don’t always have an opportunity to practice with advanced teachers. YI has given me inspiration and guidance to further my practice and my teaching. Sending thanks and love!

Has a lot of bugs. I like what they are trying to do with this app but there’s bugs in video playback. Some videos sound doesn’t work and also can’t listen with screen not active or outside of app which is difficult. Have to keep touching the screen so that it doesn’t go idol and lose the sound
Don’t do it. Don’t waste your money. You Tube has a better selection.

I would give zero stars if I could.. I would give zero stars if I could. I got sick shortly after signing up for the free trial period. I have loss of mobility and dexterity of my limbs and paralysis throughout my body. I haven’t been able to use the app at all! I tried to cancel my free trial and the website wouldn’t let me, so I contacted customer support. During this time the free trial ends and they charge me for the next month. I explain the situation and ask for a refund but it’s more important for this company to make $14 than make an exception for a SICK PERSON. This company is so horrible! How can you promote health, wellness and balance when you are a company who sees things in black and white? They are making me keep the app active until the month is up even though I am on the way to a wheel chair. Thanks Yoga International for being a sell out!
Website needs updating. Hard to find classes, not efficient. Some older classes very poor quality
Can’t scroll on my iPhone. Read the title.

Cannot download courses purchased online!. From app description, it looks as though you can do courses you’ve purchased on their site... once in app under FAQ one learns otherwise. Gave two stars because that’s the only reason I downloaded it - to work on a course during long flights. Maybe their classes are good. Can’t say. Annoying... change your description.

Classes great, app functionality pretty awful. I enjoy the classes, teachers and overall content and at happy to keep subscribing. However, the app barely works for scrolling through classes, especially if you attempt to filter by duration, etc. This really makes the process annoying so I’m thinking of quitting unless it’s resolved. Very unfortunate as the content and level of teaching is quite good and will be hard to replace.
Great classes, glitchy app. I love the classes, but the app itself is very glitchy. Scroll feature gets stuck a lot and it is difficult to search through the classes and course.
Great videos. Very good interface

Great content awful app. The content is great but whenever I enter different sections eg. favorites, I’m not able to scroll. At first I thought it was Miky phone or a short term big. Now 6 months later it’s still happening! It blocks me from practicing yoga and totally frustrates me. Please fix the app bugs! They are a big deal for its users.
Great carry on. A way to open a window to other disciplines and forms, for those of us who appreciate home practice, and for the to go kind of scheduling

Partners. I have found so much support and education through Yoga International that I consider them my yoga business partner. I subscribe to, purchase from, enjoy and I am eternally grateful to Yoga International for their presence and value in my life and teaching practice.

Meh. This might be a good app for beginners at home who are nervous about going to a class for the first time. I tried 2 full videos and watched the beginning of several but had a hard time getting into it or feeling challenged. It was missing an engagement factor.

I am so impressed with the Yoga International team, that I have recommended it to friends and I equally recommend it to anyone, for that matter. 

As I said above, the instructors at and the services provided by the Yoga International are a class act.
